title: The Protector
hook: How does The Protector end in Season 4? Hakan's lineage, Zeynep's fall, and the death of Faysal, explained.

sections.heading: Hakan's bloodline hides a betrayal
sections.body: The final season has Hakan Demir travelling back and forth through time, becoming his ancestor Harun by using the key. As he moves through the past, the story uncovers that Harun's killing of the Vizier was actually plotted by Faysal, the Immortal who could not strike the blow himself without being cursed. The deepest revelation reshapes everything about Hakan's identity. His lineage is special not by accident but because Faysal was Harun's own father. The Protector and the great enemy he has fought across four seasons are bound together by blood, turning the war into something far more intimate.

sections.heading: Zeynep crosses to the dark side
sections.body: Zeynep takes the Immortals' cure and becomes an Immortal herself, but the change carries a price. Because Faysal's blood now runs through her veins, she is pulled toward his darkness and begins doing his bidding, even killing people who were once her friends without mercy. Her descent looks complete, the loyal ally turned weapon of the enemy. Yet a thread of her old self survives. Zeynep discovers that no matter how far she falls, she cannot bring herself to let Hakan die, and that single limit becomes the crack in Faysal's control over her that the finale turns upon.

sections.heading: Hakan kills Faysal and sacrifices himself
sections.body: In the climax, Faysal tries to convert Hakan into an Immortal so the two can ruin Istanbul together, fulfilling the dark design he has chased for centuries. When the talismanic shirt finally loses its power and Faysal moves to kill Hakan, Zeynep intervenes, stopping Faysal and carrying Hakan to safety, her loyalty to him overriding the blood pulling her toward darkness. Hakan rejects the offer of immortality and instead kills Faysal, ending the Immortal threat to the city. The act costs him, framed as a sacrifice, closing the long struggle between the Protector and the enemy who was also his ancestor's father.

sections.heading: Full circle at the shop
sections.body: After the cosmic battle resolves, the series brings Hakan back to where he began. He is shown once more working at his adoptive father's shop, the ordinary place he once despised, now carrying himself as a man genuinely at peace. He is reunited with Zeynep, and after seasons of a will-they-won't-they romance the two finally come together for a lasting happy ending. Zeynep becomes a professor while Hakan tends the shop, both having survived their darkest turns. The story of the last Protector of Istanbul ends not on a battlefield but in a quiet, earned normal life.

final_image: Hakan stands at his adoptive father's shop, the place he once hated, reunited with Zeynep and at peace, the Protector's war over and an ordinary life finally his.

lingering_questions.q: How is Faysal connected to Hakan?
lingering_questions.a: The finale reveals Faysal was the father of Harun, Hakan's ancestor, making Hakan's special bloodline a direct result of Faysal's lineage. The enemy and the Protector are tied together by blood.

lingering_questions.q: Do Hakan and Zeynep end up together?
lingering_questions.a: Yes. Despite Zeynep becoming an Immortal and turning dark, she cannot let Hakan die and saves him. After Faysal is killed, the two reunite, with Zeynep becoming a professor and Hakan at peace running the shop.
